full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J.: This appeal by way of leave, at the instance of the plaintiffs, arises out of an order setting aside abatement of a suit for declaration of title to and confirmation of possession in the land measuring an area of 12.61 acres appertaining to CS Khatian No. 351 of mouza Kamardha under police station Porsha.
